meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: Claude 会先派出子代理去查找文档和实际 API,再产出分阶段的实施计划。每阶段写明任务、文档出处、验证方式与禁止事项,最后做整体核对。
howto.when: 当你要求规划功能、任务或多步骤实现时,尤其是在用 do 执行之前触发。

say.text: 帮我为“添加导出按钮”写一份分阶段实施计划。
say.note: 会先做文档调研,再给你带验证清单的计划。

say.text: 把下面的任务拆成三步计划,每步写明验证方式。
say.note: 输出会包含每步的文档出处和反模式提醒。

say.text: 先查本仓库的 API 文档,别假设,再规划重构方案。
say.note: 这条会先走 Phase 0 文档调研。

howto.what_en: Claude deploys subagents to search docs and real APIs first, then produces a phased implementation plan. Each phase includes tasks, doc references, a verification checklist, and anti-pattern guards, followed by final verification.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Make a phased implementation plan for adding an export button.
say_en.note: It starts with Phase 0 doc discovery before planning.

say_en.text: Break this task into three steps and give a verification method for each.
say_en.note: The plan will cite docs and warn against anti-patterns.

say_en.text: Search the repo docs first, don't assume APIs, then plan the refactor.
say_en.note: This routes through doc discovery first.
